scenarios.name: Sort recent thumbnail cards by name and reverse the order

scenario_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with an isolated Recent profile prepared from a disposable copy of `fixtures/cad/home-recent-native`
the Home workspace is active in the MCAD Software
recent documents with different names are shown in Grid View
Sort by is set to Last Opened in descending order
the user opens the Sort by menu
it offers Name, Location, Date Modified, Last Opened, Size and Area
the visible cards are ordered by name in descending order
the user activates the sort direction control
the visible cards are ordered by name in ascending order
